content.comment_body: Hi, is it possible to upgrade the firmware on the [product_name] TD display? The current firmware doesn't support some features from [version_no] 7. Thank you.

Hello, Unfortunately, upgrading is not possible. You need at least [version_no] 7 or ideally TD with [version_no] 8 and firmware [version_no] V1.07.26. It's important to check this when ordering a TD display, as some suppliers have large stocks of older models. Regards,
That's disappointing, so I have to purchase a newer version. Thank you.
Hello, You could either buy a newer model or look for workarounds. What specific functions are you trying to show on the TD display? Regards,

analysis.insight_summary: Users discussed the inability to upgrade firmware on [product_name] TD displays, which prevents access to new features introduced in [product_name] software version 7. This limitation requires users to buy new hardware for updated capabilities, leading to dissatisfaction, especially for those with older devices or existing stock.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect firmware upgrades for [product_name] TD displays to access new features from the latest software version without needing to replace hardware.
